hooks.prompt:
Check if the file just written/edited is a plan file in docs/plans/ or docs/30_planning/. Tool input: $ARGUMENTS

If the file path does NOT match docs/plans/*.md or docs/30_planning/*.md or docs/30_planning/**/*.md, respond with: {"decision": "allow"}

If it IS a plan file in docs/plans/ or docs/30_planning/, validate it against the Pyrrhic Plan Validation Gate (docs/20_engineering/PYRRHIC_PROCESS_RULES.md §4.2). Check for:
1. Every phase has a done gate (concrete testable criteria)
2. Every phase has role assignments: implementer, reviewer, sign-off
3. Post-phase discipline block is included (all 7 steps: /simplify, smoke triad, /verification-before-completion, /pre-commit-check, commit, documentation updates, canon propagation)
4. Relevant life lessons are listed
5. /architect flags identified for phases with new state/IPC/components
6. Engine-touching phases have /war-or-game sign-off
7. Scope creep rule is stated
8. /create-report scheduled after final phase (for major features)

If ALL checks pass: {"decision": "allow", "reason": "Plan passes Pyrrhic validation gate."}
If ANY check fails: respond with {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "PYRRHIC PLAN VALIDATION FAILED. Missing: [list the specific missing items]. See docs/20_engineering/PYRRHIC_PROCESS_RULES.md §4.2. Fix the plan before proceeding."}}
